topics.title: Synthetic Foundations: Sets and Equivalence Relations
topics.summary: Synthetic toy example covering basic set operations, De Morgan's laws, equivalence relations, and set partitions.

topics.title: Synthetic Metric Spaces and Contractions
topics.summary: Synthetic toy example covering metric axioms, Cauchy sequences, completeness, and the Banach contraction principle.

concepts.name: Set Operations and De Morgan Laws
concepts.short_statement: Fundamental subset, union, intersection, Cartesian product, and complement duality laws on arbitrary collections.

concepts.name: Equivalence Relation
concepts.short_statement: A reflexive, symmetric, and transitive binary relation partitioning an underlying set into disjoint classes.

concepts.name: Metric Space
concepts.short_statement: A nonempty set equipped with a symmetric, positive-definite distance function obeying the triangle inequality.

concepts.name: Banach Contraction Principle
concepts.short_statement: Every contraction mapping on a nonempty complete metric space possesses a unique fixed point approached geometrically.

micro_edges.evidence: Equivalence relations are subsets of the Cartesian product A x A.
A metric is defined as a map on the Cartesian product X x X.
The Banach contraction theorem relies on completeness and the metric triangle inequality.
